# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We pledge to make taking part in QSO Graph free of harassment, and open, welcoming and inclusive for
everyone, whatever their age, body, disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and
expression, level of experience, education, nationality, appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity
and orientation.

## Our standards

- Be respectful and constructive, in issues, pull requests, discussions and reviews.
- Show empathy and kindness, and welcome newcomers to the hobby and to the code.
- Accept constructive criticism gracefully, and give it the same way.
- No harassment, trolling, insults, or personal or political attacks.
- Never publish anyone's private information, such as a home address or e-mail address, without their
  permission.

## Scope

This code applies in every QSO Graph repository and space, and when someone represents the project
elsewhere.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the maintainers through GitHub: on the comment, issue or pull
request, open the **⋯** menu, select **Report content**, and choose to report it to the repository's
maintainers. Reports stay private. Never report conduct in a public issue.

## Enforcement

Maintainers will review every report, keep the reporter's identity private, and act as they judge
fit: a warning, removing content, or a temporary or permanent ban from the project's spaces.
